Maya: Quick check — we need to finalize DP intake commitments for the onramp cohort. Key Qs: what do partners commit to, what do we promise, and what's the public-beta unlock?
Jon: Propose lanes: Baseline (self-serve), Priority Onramp (fast turn), Dedicated Support (paid deep integration). Keep names distinct from previous cohorts.
Priya: Partner commitments: 4-week feedback cadence, provide 50 anonymized prompts, and enable structured telemetry (request_id, model_version, latencies).
Sam: Our promises per lane: Baseline=docs+1hr office hours, Priority=dedicated SRE handoff within 48h, Dedicated=schedule dev pairing + SLA.
Elena: Launch gate idea: public beta unlock if (a) 4 partners across 3 verticals, (b) cohort median time-to-first-success <48h, (c) no critical regressions in 14 days.
Maya: Scope negotiation: anything >30 dev-hours counts as billable concierge work. require partners to sign a short SOW for those.
Jon: I'll add an intake field: "expected dev hours" and "privacy tier". Routing rule: privacy tier = 'high' => Dedicated Support invite.
OpsBot: Infra note: reserved GPU capacity for Priority Onramp = 5 slots. alert if priority_count >5.
Priya: Metrics to instrument: acceptance_rate, onboarding_dropoff, time_to_first_success, prompt_coverage. target acceptance >60% and dropoff <25%.
Maya: Action items: Jon -> route + intake fields (ETA EOD). Priya -> telemetry spec + dashboard (ETA Tue). Elena -> invite copy + SOW template (ETA today). Sam -> confirm GPU buffer (ETA EOD). Reopen when PR is posted. :rocket:
